assumptions: X and nonempty Y are compact subsets of finite-dimensional Euclidean spaces
Phi has a shared finite Lipschitz constant lambda on compact X times Y
f belongs to C^Y(X), hence f equals its Y-X biconjugate
the closure topology is the uniform norm
quantifiers: For every epsilon > 0 and every f in C^Y(X), there exists a finite Y_tilde subset Y and g in C^{Y_tilde}(X) with ||f-g||_infinity < epsilon.
stronger_uniform_support_statement: For every epsilon > 0, one finite epsilon/(4*lambda)-net Y_tilde works for every f in C^Y(X).
zero_lipschitz_case: All branches are identical in y; any singleton support is exact.
